speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with postpartum fever and abdominal tenderness; please tell me how many days postpartum you are and whether you have experienced chills, nausea, or foul-smelling vaginal discharge.

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis (suspected with urinary retention and ileus). I have reached my question limit and am providing a provisional diagnosis based on your history of prolonged labor, uterine tenderness, frequency of urination, and decreased bowel sounds. I recommend immediate evaluation with a pelvic ultrasound and urinalysis to confirm infection and rule out urinary obstruction or retained products.
